pass_b_english: Those who speak from their belly are not a sensible nation towards God.
It is foolish for them to seek something from the living about the dead.
The law was given to help them, so that they might say what is right.
Emmanuel weaves a catechetical word for those who have hope in him, who were enrolled among children, and they were given to him by God and the Father, as Savior and Redeemer and Life-giver.
He completely separates them from ancient habits and the madness of the first, which included loving oracles from demons and clinging to certain necromancers who say nothing true.
Instead, he teaches them to seek God and learn from him, rather than accepting the counsel of those who speak from their own belly.
For they speak from their own belly, and they are not a sensible nation, so as to seek God and learn something from him.
You see how it works out foolishly: it not only commands to depart from their darkness and mind-destroying, but also to become good advisors to those who have been misled.
The common and human reasoning is to ask what the dead have to do with the living.
What kind of reasoning would it be to ask about the living from those in the earth or in Hades?

It is completely ignorant to pay attention to necromancy and the false boasts of sorcerers who have a dead mind and a frozen heart, for they do not know the creator of all things and do not have the life-giving word of God within them.
If someone were to come, saying, 'Seek those who speak from the earth, that is, those who pretend to bring up the dead; and as if making prophecies from Hades;', they should not accept their counsel.
The living, who have the heavenly life-giving power within themselves and have been enriched by the living word of God, ask what the dead have to do with the living.
They should say to those who counsel with them, 'What do they seek from the living about the dead?'

The law has been given as help, that is, the evangelical law, so that those who pay attention to it may say: 'Not like this word, for which no gifts can be given.', for those who speak from their own heart sell falsehood, but the saving and true law of God.

Ventriloquists, who pretend to have certain gods in their belly, so that they speak the things from them to those who come, and who make prophecies as if from Hades, do not know the creator of all things and do not have the life-giving word of God within them, and they are concerned with the works of the dead.
